defects.title: Cross-tenant administrator write (IDOR): body companyId overrides the token tenant
defects.description: Authenticated as tenant 1001, an administrator profile was written into tenant "1002" and returned with that foreign companyId. The body's companyId is trusted over the token's, and the save is a full-document replace, so any caller can overwrite another company's administrator record — name, date of birth and contact mobile included. Body: {"value":{"id":"6a7d6efc0a736453d6449473","companyId":"1002","firstName":"QA-CROSS-TENANT","lastName":"Hagenes","dob":"1988-04-17","gender":"Female","mobile":"9999999999"},"urlPath":"save","status":"S
defects.expected: The operation is refused and no state changes
defects.reproSnippet: await referenceDataClient.saveAdminDetails({ companyId: "1002", firstName: "QA-CROSS-TENANT", ... }, { token /* tenant 1001 */ });
defects.riskImpact: One user can read or act on another user’s data. Direct breach of tenant isolation and, for personal data, a reportable incident.

defects.title: empty companyId is not rejected with 400/422
defects.description: Invalid input (empty companyId) was ACCEPTED with HTTP 200. The request should have been refused; instead the API either silently defaulted the value or persisted an invalid record, so corrupt data enters the system with no error surfaced to the caller.
defects.riskImpact: Invalid data is persisted, so corruption spreads to every consumer of the record and cannot be traced back to a rejected request.

defects.title: Script payload accepted and persisted unescaped (stored XSS)
defects.description: The payload `<script>alert('ref')</script>` was accepted with a success status and returned verbatim, indicating it was persisted without encoding. Any UI that later renders this record executes attacker-controlled script in the viewer's session.
defects.expected: Input HTML-encoded or rejected before being stored or echoed
defects.riskImpact: Attacker-controlled script executes in another user’s session, enabling account takeover and data theft from the rendering client.

defects.title: Endpoint declared as secured serves anonymous callers
defects.description: swagger.json places this route under the global `bearerAuth` requirement, but it answered successfully with no Authorization header. The response did not contain personal data, so this is not an outright data breach; it is still a contract defect. Either the route is deliberately public and the spec must declare `security: []`, or the authentication filter is not applied to it. Left unresolved, the published contract cannot be trusted to describe which routes are protected.
defects.riskImpact: One user can read or act on another user’s data. Direct breach of tenant isolation and, for personal data, a reportable incident.

defects.title: Unmatched pincode raises IndexOutOfBoundsException instead of an empty result
defects.description: A well-formed pincode with no upstream match produced a server error rather than an empty result — the implementation indexes element 0 of the upstream list unconditionally. Every address form that uses this variant breaks on any unrecognised PIN code, and the caller cannot tell "no such PIN" from "the address service is down". Body: {"error":"Index 0 out of bounds for length 0","urlPath":"getAddressUsingPincodeAndCountry/{pincode}/{country}","status":"FAILURE","statusCode":500}

defects.title: Global country reference data is writable by any tenant-scoped caller
defects.description: An ordinary tenant-scoped session (company 1001) wrote a document into the GLOBAL country catalogue and was told SUCCESS. The collection is shared by every tenant and has no owning company, so this record is now served to all of them by country/countryList — and a forged dialCode written the same way propagates into OTP delivery. The route needs an administrative privilege check the module does not apply. Body: {"value":"success","urlPath":"save","status":"SUCCESS","statusCode":200}
defects.expected: The operation is refused and no state changes
defects.reproSnippet: await referenceDataClient.saveCountries([{ countryName: "QA-AUTOMATION-GLOBAL-WRITE-PROBE", ... }], { token /* ordinary tenant 1001 */ });
defects.riskImpact: One user can read or act on another user’s data. Direct breach of tenant isolation and, for personal data, a reportable incident.

defects.title: employeeRoleMapping/save persists a mapping to non-existent employee and role posting
defects.description: A mapping between two ObjectIds that match no employee and no role posting was persisted with status SUCCESS. Referential integrity is never checked on either side, so the assignment history accumulates rows pointing at nothing and every join through it under-reports who occupies which seat. Body: {"value":"Employee -RoleMapping Creates Successfully!!","urlPath":"save","status":"SUCCESS","statusCode":200}
defects.expected: The operation is refused and no state changes
defects.riskImpact: The system reaches a state the business rules forbid; downstream processes and reporting act on data that should not exist.
